Title: Apply themes to Power BI Embedded dashboards

Body.Content:
In Power BI Embedded, you can now embed dashboards that include themes, similarly to report themes.

With dashboard themes, you can apply a color theme to the dashboard that your users consume. You use the Power BI portal to set and apply the dashboard theme.
